en:
I bumped into Kaito, and he ended up giving
me a lecture.
He told me to think of a way to escape...

But the only idea I can think of is becoming the
blackened myself. That'd entertain everyone.

<CLT=cltMIND>What should I do? Should I hang out with
Kokichi, even though he's like this?

<CLT=cltMIND>What should I do? Should I hang out with
Kokichi, even though he's like this?

Nee-heehee, I'm lying!
Don't give me such a scary face!

Here, you want some bubble gum? It's my last
one, but I'll give it if you reeeally want it!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today,
despite my misgivings...
